summary.en: The tally arc: count the set into squares, re-sort the same squares chapter by chapter, read time and trend, close on the few numbers that matter.
summary.zh: tally 的骨架：把集合数成方块，每章重排同一批方块，读时间与趋势，最后收束到几个关键数字。

fits: Data stories told by counting: registries, surveys, archives, the proof part of a release.
notFor: Films without a countable set; product demos.

intent.en: A counted set becomes an answer chapter by chapter without ever changing its items.
intent.zh: 一个被计数的集合一章一章变成答案，始终是同一批东西。

content.en: Scenes for each slot (see the card); the style's look and sound.
content.zh: 每个槽的场景（见卡片）；该风格的样式与声音。

fits.zh: 用计数讲的数据故事：名录、调查、档案、发布片的证据段。

notFor.zh: 没有可数集合的片；产品演示。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead against the original template's scene order and lengths (card, Differs from upstream)
